title: pytest-xdist.md's -n auto fact omits that PYTEST_XDIST_AUTO_NUM_WORKERS and the hook win before psutil
goal: kb/public/python/pytest-xdist.md's -n auto fact says PYTEST_XDIST_AUTO_NUM_WORKERS and the pytest_xdist_auto_num_workers hook decide the count before psutil, as plugin.py's resolution order does

run: import re,sys;t=open('kb/public/python/pytest-xdist.md',encoding='utf-8').read();p=[x for x in re.split(r'\n(?=- )',t) if x.startswith('- `-n auto` uses')];sys.exit(0 if p and 'PYTEST_XDIST_AUTO_NUM_WORKERS' in p[0] else 1)
